after_answers.agent_answer: Your team's on-call rotation is a paired on-call system, meaning there is both a primary and a secondary on-call person. For managing notifications effectively, it is recommended to ensure that both the primary and secondary receive alerts simultaneously. Using a dedicated on-call management tool with escalation policies is advised, so if the primary does not acknowledge an alert within a set time, it escalates to the secondary. Additionally, setting quiet hours or specific times to minimize notifications can help reduce alert fatigue. Regularly reviewing and adjusting notification settings based on team feedback is also beneficial to ensure the system works well for everyone.
